Featured work

REDWOOD MATERIALS/CURRENT ROLE

Firmware tests on hardware

Problem: hand testing is slow, and easy to skip.

Result: HIL tests in Python and pytest over CAN bus check every change. End-of-line tests run on the Pack Manager and on the combiner box, also called the gateway EOL. I work with the firmware team, find field issues, and feed them back into testing. Bugs get caught in the lab.

In plain English

Pack Manager: the box that links used EV packs to a storage site and evens out their power. EOL: the final test before a unit ships. HIL: firmware tested on the hardware itself. CAN bus: the network parts use to talk.

REDWOOD MATERIALS/CONTROLS LEAD

A battery sorting line, built from nothing

Problem: Redwood had no line that could sort batteries by chemistry. No prior version existed.

Result: Controls Lead, from an empty site to a running line. 10+ axis EtherCAT, with vision, laser, and weight checks. One TwinCAT 3 library runs every axis. Data direct to the cloud, no middleware. First CI/CD pipeline for the PLC codebase.

In plain English

Battery sorting line: cameras spot each used battery's chemistry, then the line routes it to the right place. PLC: the computer that runs factory machines.

INDEPENDENT PROJECT/PYTHON RESEARCH SYSTEM

ORB-LAB: trading tests in Python

Problem: a trading idea looks good until you count the costs and check it for tricks in the data.

Result: every strategy gets a backtest with costs counted, plus lookahead and survivorship audits, checked against buy and hold. Paper trading only. Ideas that fail the audit get cut.

In plain English

Backtest: trying a trading idea on old prices. Paper trading: practice trades, no money moves.

  • Python
  • Alpaca API
  • Backtesting
  • Paper trading
  • Risk controls
  • EOD reporting
03

How I work

1

Built to be reused

I build tests and libraries other engineers can run and extend. At Redwood, one motion library put every axis on the same code.

2

Fail means stop

Code does not land on a failed check. I built CI that way for the PLC codebase and run my own apps the same way.

3

Prove it with numbers

I find the failure mode first, then prove the fix held. That is how the Tesla defect rate went from 4% to 0.4%.

4

No repeat bugs

A bug that ships gets a test, so it cannot ship again. Findings become checks, not notes in a doc.

REDWOOD MATERIALS · BATTERY ENERGY STORAGE · JUL 2026 TO PRESENT

Firmware tests on hardware

The problem

Testing by hand is slow, and it gets skipped when time is tight. That is when bugs slip through.

What I built

  • Python and pytest tests that run firmware on rigs, over CAN bus.
  • EOL and HIL testing on the Pack Manager.
  • EOL and HIL testing on the combiner box, also called the gateway EOL.
  • I work with the firmware team, find field issues, and feed them back into testing.
  • The test infrastructure and CI that run all of it.

When a test fails

The report says which test failed and what the hardware did. That helps us tell a firmware bug from a rig or wiring fault, and fix the right one.

Result: every change gets a clear pass or fail on hardware. Bugs show up in the lab, not in a finished system.
